notes.title: Bruce Wayne's Birthday Sale!
notes.content:
In honor of Bruce Wayne's birthday, WB Games is offering savings of up to 90% on these great DC Comics-themed games!  

[h2][b]SUICIDE SQUAD[/b][/h2]
From Rocksteady Studios, the creators of the Batman Arkham series, Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League is a genre-defying third-person action shooter where the ultimate band of misfits must do the impossible to save the world: Kill the Justice League.

[h2][b]BATMAN: ARKHAM SERIES[/b][/h2]
Become Batman in this best-selling, award-winning action-adventure trilogy! From deep storylines, to fun gameplay, classic DC super-villains and top voice talent, Arkham Asylum, Arkham City and Arkham Knight have it all!

[h2][b]GOTHAM KNIGHTS[/b][/h2]
Gotham Knights is an open-world, action RPG set in the most dynamic and interactive Gotham City yet. Patrol Gotham's five distinct boroughs in solo or in co-op and drop in on criminal activity wherever you find it. Your legacy begins now. Step into the Knight.

[h2][b]INJUSTICE 1 and 2[/b][/h2]
Developers of the best-selling and critically acclaimed MORTAL KOMBAT franchise, NetherRealm Studios brings unrivaled storytelling, robust content, and best-in-class fighting mechanics to the DC Universe in Injustice Gods Among Us and Injustice 2.

[h2][b]LEGO BATMAN SERIES [/b][/h2]
Batman fans of all ages will enjoy fun and original storylines in this best-selling series filled with classic LEGO videogame action and humor as players fight to put the villains back behind bars.

[h2][b]LEGO DC SUPER-VILLAINS[/b][/h2]
Embark on a LEGO open-world adventure by becoming the best villain the universe has seen in LEGO DC Super-Villains. For the first time, a LEGO game gives you the ability to play as a super-villain, unleashing mischievous antics and wreak havoc in an action-packed, hilarious story written in collaboration with DC Comics.

[h2][b]SCRIBBLENAUTS UNMASKED[/b][/h2]
In Scribblenauts Unmasked: A DC Comics Adventure, Maxwell unites with Batman, Superman and the rest of The Justice League to restore order to the DC Comics Universe. Challenge your imagination as you battle the mightiest villains in an exciting, action-filled adventure through GOTHAM CITY, METROPOLIS, ATLANTIS and other iconic locales from the DC Comics Universe.

notes.title: PC Major Patch Update
notes.content:
Single Player
•	Made a fix so that 'regular' challenge maps will always unlock if the 'Extreme' versions are. Fixes issues of people reporting that Hard Time, Intensive Training and Quiet Waters challenge not being unlocked properly.
•	Removing Enigma side mission icons properly when collected from a different mode consistently. 
•	Only award Initiation achievement when player is using the Initiation skin when requirements previously met.
•	Made Clean Streets trophy more forgiving. Now calculates completion of Most Wanted across all game modes, not just the one you're in.
•	Fixed an issue where Leaderboard ranks would not display correctly for some users
•	User can now execute a glide kick while in mid-glide, the same as on consoles.
•	Fixed an issue where players would get kicked back to the main menu when they lost their internet connection while in game or challenge mode. 
•	Fix for an issue where unlocking a new character profile and viewing it could cause the wrong profile to appear.
•	Fixed an issue where users could not perform a Batwing Drop Attack using a keyboard & mouse.
•	Fixed an issue where pressing "Left Mouse Button" triggered QuickStrike twice, which negated Critical strikes in battle

Multiplayer
•	Implemented Voice Chat in Multiplayer
•	Fixed a rare crash during MP game play
•	Fix for using consumables on PC
•	Fix for mouse cursor not returning on mouse movement within the front end and pause menu.
•	Fix for consumable description not updating in loadout once select has been pressed.
•	Fixed people getting dropped from Steam at the end of a round
•	Fixed crash when canceling purchase with Steam.
•	The Tab key is no longer bindable, but is hard set to control the Scoreboard command in MP.

Both
•	Added mappings for keyboard buttons to Quickfire gadgets in both SP and MP.
•	Fixed an issue where users could not map controls to mouse buttons 4 & 5.
•	Fix Alt key state not getting reset after game loses and regains focus. This prevents user from hitting F4 and the game closing. 
•	Fixed an issue on triple monitor setups where the menus may not be visible in full screen, and only the button callouts were visible.

notes.content:
This hotfix resolves the following issues:

•	Prevent benchmark map from awarding XP and saving game progress, which would block players from going back to main game.

•	Prevent the Alt+Tab keystroke from pausing the game when in the benchmark map

•	Resolves future Benchmark save corrupting issues

notes.title: Available Now - New Millennium Skins Pack
notes.content:
Batman: Arkham Origins - New Millennium Skins Pack is available now on Steam! Fans who do not already own the Season Pass can buy the skins pack individually or still purchase the full pass today. 

The pack contains six bonus skins based on a variety of classic and modern storylines pulled from the comics:

- Red Son Batman™*
- Blackest Night Batman™
- 1st Appearance Batman™
- New 52 Graphic Batman™*
- Batman™: Noel* 
- One Year Later Robin™ (available in multiplayer mode)


Players who have purchased the Batman: Arkham Origins Season Pass and are connected to the Internet will have instant access to the content that can be used in challenges maps, as well as the single-player campaign upon completion of the main story and in multiplayer for players that reach Level 2.

*Certain skins in the New Millennium Skins Pack are unlockable in-game and through playing the Batman: Arkham Origins mobile game.

notes.title: Recent Fixes
notes.content:
[list][*]Fix for the issue that was causing credits, consumables, and profile   progress to not be saved in Multiplayer. 
[*]Fix for the Burnley Tower vent that Batman wasn't able to climb up
[*]Fix for Free Flow Focus mode not unlocking upon unlocking Shadow Vigilante rank 3
[*]Fixed player falling through elevators/world in most cases. For players that were stuck in free fall loop; if you are not back into the game or if it looks weird around you when you load the game, here are the steps.
[list][*]	Go in pause menu and select Restart from Checkpoint.
[*]If Restart from checkpoint didn’t work, trying beating up all enemies around you.
[*]	If there aren’t any enemies around you, try going through a door.
[*]	Those steps should get you back into the game.

notes.title: How to Report Issues & Bugs
notes.content:
Hello,

Please report the PC bugs you are encountering in the game in the official game forums at http://community.wbgames.com/t5/Support-for-PC/bd-p/Support

When reporting your issues, to help the teams with their investigations, please include the following information by following the below instructions:

Reporting Issues/Bugs:
 
When reporting a problem you are experiencing we want to make sure we have all the information we can from the get go to allow us to help you faster!
 
You can start off by filling out this basic template of quick questions – by providing as much relevant information as possible will make it easier for us to track these issues down and address them.
 
What is the issue you are experiencing?  
•	Explain as clearly as possible what the problem is
•	Please detail if this is in single player or multiplayer
What platform are you playing on?
Where were you are experiencing this issue?
•	Examples: “Main menu” or “Old Gotham”
How long were you playing before it happened?
 
 
If reporting on PC please include Diagnostics information (please see the guide below for this).

How to collect DXDiag Logs: 
 
Collecting DirectX Diagnostics logs are going to be needed to help us help you!
These logs simply contain a readout of all your PC specifications – to allow us to know exactly what hardware you have – and this can also help us narrow down any issues you may have
 
To gather a DXDIAG on your computer, please follow the steps below:
1.	While at your desktop, Press and hold the Windows key and the letter R on your keyboard
2.	You’ll have a Run prompt show up in the lower corner of the screen
3.	Type dxdiag in the text field
4.	Click OK
5.	If prompted to “Check if your drivers are digitally signed”, select YES
6.	If your computer has the button 64-bit version of Windows, click the button Run 64-bit DXDIAG (if you have this button available, click it!)
7.	If your computer has a 32-bit version of Windows, that button will not be available
8.	Then please click: “Save all information”
9.	Save this file to your desktop and attach it to your forum post.
10.	If you are unable to attach your DXdiag to your forum post, please use this link http://pastebin.com/ where you can paste your DXdiag text and press "submit" and it will give you back a link that you can include in your forum post.
 
Quick guides:
These are quick tips or quick links to help users fix their issues faster
 
Video Driver Updates:
http://www.nvidia.com/object/nvidia-update.html
http://support.amd.com/en-us/download
 
Windows Troubleshooting guides
http://windows.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows-vista/troubleshoot-monitor-and-video-card-problems
 
We thank you for following these steps on how to report issues on these boards and appreciate your patience while our teams work diligently to help find a solution to them!
 
The Community Team
